verdict.rationale: The probe confirms there is no llms.txt (HTTP 404), and the JSON OpenAPI paths also return 404. However, several doc excerpts are sourced from a machine-readable openapi.yaml at apidocs.anrok.com, which an agent could be pointed at, and the Headless Tax page says tax can be handed to agents. That is only an indirect, glancing form of agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt, dedicated agent-oriented or markdown docs, documented guidance on pointing agents at the docs, and independent corroboration.
